Each tomato goes in as pulp: one, the oldest, or all, as many as there is room for. Kept steaming 3 hours on any stove or fire it cooks down to paste, a fifth of the pulp (10 tomatoes make two portions); 2 hours more and it scorches. Pack it into a crock, or add it to one already started. Left raw it goes off when its oldest tomato would have; cooked and not packed, it keeps about a week at room warmth.
